title: Episode 16 - Rodney Cravens - Lone Pine Farm, Hartville, Missouri
summary: Rodney, a newly appointed board member, tells us how he got into agriculture and specifically the South Poll breed. Rodney's family have been farming their land at Lone Pine Farm since 1918 but got into the South Poll breed in 2014 by purchasing fullbood South Poll bulls and utilizing the breed up program. He also shares about his personal experience with leasing farm land and his current cattle markets.

 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In April 25, 2022 Episode 16 - Rodney Cravens - Lone Pine Farm, Hartville, Missouri The South Poll Podcast 50m Listen to Rodney Craven's South Poll Story!  Rodney, a newly appointed board member, tells us how he got into agriculture and specifically the South Poll breed.  Rodney's family have been farming their land at Lone Pine Farm since 1918 but got into the South Poll breed in 2014 by purchasing fullbood South Poll bulls and utilizing the breed up program.
